title: Venom F5 vs SSC Tuatara: The Difference Nobody Explains
description:
Two American hypercars were built to be the fastest road cars on Earth. One is the Hennessey Venom F5, from Texas. The other is the SSC Tuatara, from Washington State. On paper they look alike: twin-turbo V8s, carbon fibre, more than a thousand horsepower, price tags near two million dollars. But the published numbers say they are very different cars, and one of them has a past it would like you to forget. We compare engines, weight, shape, production, price and, above all, speed. We use Wikipedia for both cars, plus evo, The Drive and Motor One for the Hennessey, and Motor One and Motor Authority for the SSC. Where figures are claims, we say claims. Where they were verified, we say by whom. And where our arithmetic compares unlike numbers, we flag it.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
